stories.title: Fine Gael leader wants border poll criteria talks with London
stories.summary: Simon Harris says a conversation between the British and Irish governments over the criteria for a border poll would be "useful".

stories.title: Irish government denies 'foot-dragging' over Omagh Bombing Inquiry
stories.summary: Sir Chris Bryant urged Irish ministers to hold an inquiry when they met for the British Irish Intergovernmental Conference.

stories.title: 'Dad was deteriorating': Two-hour ambulance target missed more than 2,000 times
stories.summary: The Release to Rescue initiative was introduced this year to cut ambulance delays and speed up handover times.

stories.title: Rape and child sexual abuse arrests in Presbyterian Church investigation
stories.summary: Two arrests as part of an investigation into the Presbyterian Church in Ireland, were in relation to sexual communication with a child and rape.

stories.title: Four men arrested in extreme right-wing terrorism investigation
stories.summary: Four men have been arrested in Bangor and Belfast as part of an investigation into extreme right-wing terrorism.

stories.title: Blue Lights and Celebrity Traitors most watched BBC programmes in NI
stories.summary: That is according to the communications regulator Ofcom.

stories.title: Covid inquiry urges UK–Ireland pandemic co-ordination in future
stories.summary: In its latest report into the programme of test and trace, it said cooperation was needed "to ensure that border control measures are effective and operable in practice".

stories.title: Hooker Sheehan named at number eight for Boks game
stories.summary: Ireland captain Dan Sheehan is named at number eight for Saturday's highly anticipated Nations Championship match against world champions South Africa in Dublin.

stories.title: 'Time and money wasted' as police sent to court without testifying
stories.summary: Police and other experts are "routinely" taken away from other work to attend court, a report finds.

stories.title: Tourist jailed for damaging Belfast's Big Fish
stories.summary: A man has been jailed for five months after causing an estimated £10,000 worth of damage to Belfast's Big Fish sculpture.

stories.title: Tiger Woods to design new golf course in Northern Ireland
stories.summary: Tiger Woods is to design Northern Ireland's first new championship links golf course in more than a century.

stories.title: 'Someone will be killed or seriously injured' - mum's warning after car ramming
stories.summary: Laura Moore's husband and son were in her car when it was rammed by another driver in Derry on Saturday night.
